title: Himmler's Ahnenerbe replacing Christianity with Nordic rites

tellings.quote: interpret them the same way? The Ananbbo was a real organization and it was called Ancestral Heritage

plain: In 1930s Germany, Heinrich Himmler, head of the Nazi SS, ran an organization called the Ahnenerbe, meaning Ancestral Heritage, which aimed to replace Christianity with old Nordic rites. The writer Peter Levenda, who has researched the Nazis' occult interests, tells Michels that the Ahnenerbe was a real organization, without naming a source. It matters to him as a case of a state trying to rebuild belief around an invented ancient past.
